svg.metadata: {"translation_group":"nba-bucks-pacers-2026-10-16-recap","chart":{"type":"stacked_bar","unit":"points","categories":["two_point_points","three_point_points","free_throw_points"],"players":[{"id":1629639,"name":"Tyler Herro","team":"Milwaukee Bucks","fgm":10,"fga":16,"tpm":5,"tpa":7,"ftm":0,"fta":0,"points":25,"two_point_points":10,"three_point_points":15,"free_throw_points":0,"source_id":"herro-log"},{"id":1627783,"name":"Pascal Siakam","team":"Indiana Pacers","fgm":8,"fga":10,"tpm":5,"tpa":7,"ftm":3,"fta":3,"points":24,"two_point_points":6,"three_point_points":15,"free_throw_points":3,"source_id":"siakam-log"}],"formula":"2-point points = 2 * (FGM - 3PM); 3-point points = 3 * 3PM; free-throw points = FTM.","scope":"Individual scoring composition for two players, not the teams' full scoring breakdown or a game-flow timeline."},"source_urls":["https://www.nba.com/watch/video/game-recap-bucks-128-pacers-127","https://www.nba.com/game/mil-vs-ind-0012600057","https://www.nba.com/player/1629639/tyler-herro","https://www.nba.com/player/1627783/pascal-siakam","https://official.nba.com/rule-no-5-scoring-and-timing/","https://ak-static.cms.nba.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/46/2026/08/2026-27-NBA-Regular-Season-Schedule-By-Date.pdf"]}
